en: Please teach me how to become a swordsmith, Seril.
The corruption of a fallen titan. The corruption of the Destroyer. After all, the staff was forged from the seed of hate. That is, of course, what has brought me here...

In death, the animals of the world bestow both life and protection unto us.  If you feel that you can offer the appropriate respect for their sacrifice, then the skinner's profession may suit you.  Speak with Eladriel in the Craftsmen's Terrace in northern Darnassus to learn more.
Elune-adore, my $gbrother:sister;. You are welcome here. Speak, and I will do what I can to aid you.
<PH> Incoming Mages <PH>
Have you seen Watcher Backus? So brave...$B$BI think he's the toughest of all the Night Watch. I wonder if he even notices I'm around....
Ah, the true sign of the hunter!  To stalk one's prey in the never-ending game of life.  Look to Drayl on the Hunter Rise for your answers.
Seems like a hundred times a day I walk all the way to the well to get more water. No respect for their elders I tell ya.
Do I look like I have the time or energy to coddle every tourist that wanders through my door? Tell me what you need, and make it quick.
Nothing must befoul the gardens! You must be destroyed!
Use your tonk action bar above your standard action bar to attack other tonks.
Well duties call, yes?  First, the bell... to give you vigor!

You are fortunate to have come to Darnassus where you can find such an accomplished Hunter as Jocaste among our trainers.  I encourage you to visit her over in the Cenarion Enclave and seek her tutelage.
Bronzebeard's gone missing again! That dwarf sure didn't get any of his brother's good senses.
Finally...death!  Curse you, Hakkar!  Curse you!
They say Duriel is a fierce night elf.  It'll be a good fight!
Here's the eastern mountain wall!  I'm cutting towards the south now; try and keep up.  We're not out of the thick of it yet!
I can teach you the finer points of Horse Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

You need to be stronger, $c before you can help us in Alterac Valley.
Alterac Valley
Yeah yeah, I know Dadanga dislikes smoke.  From the smell of it though, seems like Dadanga also dislikes bathing.
Either that's a prime kodo bone or it's time I got my goggles!
I believe I misplaced that banner you enchanted for me, Falrin.

I'm sorry $g mon : sis;, but I won't be sellin' my raptors to someone who hasn't proven themselves to be a friendly to the Darkspear tribe.  When ya make a stand and show yourself to be at least friendly to us, then I'll make my raptors available to ya.
Perhaps one day, your contributions to the Alliance will be as great as the heroes you have seen this day. Honor them, $n.

In the northeastern Barrens lies a pool of water sickened by pollution.  The locals call it the Sludge Fen; the Venture Company has turned the once crystal-blue waters into a mire of industrial byproducts and waste.  In the heart of this fen lies what you seek, $n.$B$BBe warned - the Venture Company does not tolerate trespassers, and they consider anyone who does not work for them as such.  You'll especially be a target as a protector of nature, something they vehemently oppose.
Drek'Thar is the military and spiritual leader of the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac, leading his brethren from Frostwolf Keep.$B$BIf he is defeated then the Horde forces in Alterac will crumble.
%s hands the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to Fandral Staghelm.

The time for war is almost upon us, $c! Both the Horde and the Alliance have finished with their preparations. All of our war materiel is being shipped to Silithus as we speak. I'd expect the last of it to arrive within a day. When all is assembled there, the one who has completed the arduous task of reassembling the Scepter of the Shifting Sands will bang it against the Scarab Gong and open the gates to Ahn'Qiraj. Then battle shall be joined as has not been seen in ages!$B$BLok'tar Ogar!
THIS EVENT IS WORKING.
Dreadlords? Perhaps you mean Lord Banehollow. He sends his regards, and has a message for you...
I just gave kill credit to $n.
Now, watch...
This is Rigger Gizelton asking for assistance escorting my caravan past Mannoroc Coven. I'm on the road east of Shadowprey village.
They must have had someone helping them.
Sto-o-op! Make it stop!!
Exalted.
Follow me and I'll open the courtyard door for you.
Bravo, Gerard, you have exceeded yourself, yet again.
Let them feel the wrath of the Blue Flight! May Malygos protect me!
You were telling me about The Veiled Blade and how you took the wrong mission.
